query:
DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT MIN(id) FROM inventory 
  WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05' 
  GROUP BY productName, branchId
) AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05'
